# @amykit/plugin-github

GitHub as the code host, through the gh CLI.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `code-host` port.

Use it when the code lives on GitHub. It mounts the code-host port that ticket-to-qa and pull-request need to open pull requests, request reviews and read review threads, and that errand and note-to-plan reach when they open their drafts. It talks to GitHub through the gh CLI, so gh must be installed and logged in.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `code-host` |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-github
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-github"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-github":
    baseBranch: {}
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `baseBranch` | `record` | no | `{}` | where one repository's base branch is, instead of the fallback. A repository named here has its work cut from, and its pull requests opened against, that branch |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
